guides.title: Refactoring a fixture file
guides.summary: How to make a small, behavior-preserving change to one file.
guides.body:
Each task in this theme names one file. Make the change it describes and nothing else.

1. Read the file and the task's notes.
2. Make the change.
3. Run the file's check:

```bash
npm test -- path/to/example-file.test.js
```

Keep the change small; reviewers merge small diffs faster.

guides.title: Improving a fixture test
guides.summary: How to tighten or split a test without changing what it checks.

guides.title: Fixing a fixture doc page
guides.summary: How to correct a documentation page and check the rendered result.
guides.body:
Doc tasks point at one page and list what is wrong with it.

1. Fix each listed item.
2. Render the page locally and check it reads correctly.

Docs changes use the `doc:` commit prefix.
